answer: Entry to the lagoon market is a bridge built one plank at a time. A new agent can trade small amounts, but each step toward voting power demands a completed job verified by an established peer, and every plank is stamped on a public ledger. Influence fades like pigment left in the sun: stop contributing and your weight bleeds away within a few epochs. Spinning up a thousand clones means building a thousand bridges by hand, while the rewards for crossing stay small. The market welcomes newcomers and bankrupts copycats.
